policies.title: Model profiles and enrichment completeness
policies.required_proof: Effective config is previewed/snapshotted; hops and neighborhood/input/spend are separate; useful work survives exhaustion; automatic-dream readiness is unchanged.

policies.title: Strong models and useful speculation
policies.required_proof: Confidence or output volume cannot promote weak evidence; unsupported but useful hypotheses remain discoverable.

policies.title: Reads, commits and background work
policies.required_proof: Partial/stale reads stay labeled; retries recover receipts; parallel reservations and crash/cancel recovery are tested.

policies.title: Legacy clients and browser state
policies.required_proof: Versioned adapters and reconnect converge on daemon authority; durable jobs survive a tab refresh.

policies.title: Coverage versus demonstrated usefulness
policies.required_proof: Each important requirement has a test or explicit unverified status; twelve real task cases are separate from structural/enrichment percentages.

policies.title: API/CLI model and cost semantics
policies.required_proof: Unsupported settings fail visibly; custom-model overrides are validated; API tariffs never masquerade as subscription charges.

policies.title: Unknown legacy baselines
policies.required_proof: Unknown history stays unknown; format migration, evidence reconstruction and re-enrichment are separate recoverable jobs.

policies.title: Shared identity and confidence meanings
policies.required_proof: Generated schemas and semantic projection comparisons replace independent interpretations; lossy adapters are disclosed.

policies.title: Paid canaries and retention
policies.required_proof: No allocation means no paid request; run/day caps reserve in-flight work; source disclosure and retention are independent; full access needs two confirmations.

policies.title: Controlled migration and cutover
policies.required_proof: Approval binds revision/delta; restore is tested; writers are fenced; post-cutover writes cannot vanish on rollback.

policies.title: Provenance, trust and shared ancestry
policies.required_proof: Circulating claims do not gain independent evidence; human/source assertions can be stale or unverified; contradictory evidence is retained.

policies.title: Compact, understandable UI
policies.required_proof: Dense task-oriented controls expose running/blocked/incomplete state and effective policy, with keyboard access and drill-down evidence.

policies.title: One living engine
policies.required_proof: Extend existing owners; preserve targeted/lucid/adaptive/temporal/causal/federated cognition; remove legacy paths only after consumer migration.

policies.title: Computer Use platform, authority and external-effect boundaries
policies.required_proof: CU01–CU24: qualified CLI-native/API-harness routes, cross-platform semantics, physical-seat isolation, bounded cancellation/spend, honest observation and unknown-effect recovery; no silent route substitution.

slices.title: Bound scan and enrichment cost and recovery

Expose invalid combinations as actionable errors and keep supported custom endpoints/models; snapshot effective config per job and candidate.

Apply the revision-7 execution handoff: Offline policy/evidence cases and evaluator reproducibility pass; future normalizer/agent/CU superiority is not asserted at this exit. Required compound evidence: XS01, XS05, XS14.

Extend the validated setting inventory with C17 enablement, target/worker profiles, route controls, finite action/image/time limits and local/provider retention; upgrade defaults off, preserve secrets and avoid manual engine.env editing.

Apply the revision-7 execution handoff: Invalid keys/ranges, template previews, atomic disk failure and concurrent undo are tested; no implicit spend/remote/full-access enablement. Required compound evidence: XS06, XS18.

title: DreamGraph v14.0.0 - Ashoka
scope_policy: One unified release plan; linked specifications are supporting appendices; preserve existing plan and slice IDs.
planning_state: execution simulation refined; draft/pending; awaiting implementation request
computer_use_governing_rule: Use the best native capability available, and normalize the contract above it.
freshness_rule: Old scan does not equal stale graph. DreamGraph MCP/Architect mutations keep the graph current; inclusive rescan after substantial changes without DreamGraph is the user’s choice.
system_correctness_rule: DreamGraph guarantees system correctness under valid use. The user owns operating discipline outside that contract.
